research_rule: Математика не сходится. Пока не сойдется.
hypothesis: Compact exact boundary messages can survive cyclic internal entanglement whose projected boundary relation is genuinely non-affine, if JANUS can switch from typed affine composition to a more general canonical symbolic representation without explicit 2^k enumeration or hidden exponential migration on the frozen ladder.
constructed_cycle: For each boundary triple (a,b,c), internal s,t,z satisfy XOR(s,t,a)=0; z=s AND b; XOR(z,t,c)=r. The internal factor graph contains s-t-z-s and its existential boundary semantics is b -> (a XOR c = r), which is non-affine.
variable_ordering: Paid min-fill order derived only from the input CNF primal graph; no generator labels or hidden block decomposition.
forbidden_shortcuts: No solver-side enumeration of 2^k boundary assignments.
No generator/family/block labels supplied to solver.
No use of hidden expected boundary relation during construction or variable ordering.
Affine fast path must reject genuinely non-affine cases.
ROBDD construction, quantification, apply operations, width/node count and serialization are fully charged.
Evaluation-only 2^k audit may run only after message construction and is separately accounted.
Finite success cannot promote P=NP or universal polynomial quantification.

gates.N1_EXACTNESS_AND_REPLAY: 100% message evaluations must match hidden independent semantic audit on frozen cases.
gates.N2_CYCLIC_INTERNAL_ENTANGLEMENT: 100% cases contain the intended shared-internal s-t-z-s factor cycle.
gates.N3_NONAFFINE_BOUNDARY_SEMANTICS: 100% cases must be rejected by the affine semantic audit/fast path.
gates.N4_ZERO_ALGORITHMIC_BOUNDARY_ENUMERATION: Solver-side boundary assignment enumeration must be zero.
gates.N5_COMPACT_ROBDD_MESSAGE: For k>=9 median reachable ROBDD nodes / 2^k <= 0.10 and max <= 0.25.
gates.N6_NO_MEASURED_EXPONENTIAL_MIGRATION: Adjacent medians for paid work, ROBDD nodes, serialization and quantification/apply ops must remain <=4x on frozen ladder; finite empirical gate only.
gates.N7_TRUTHGATE_PROOFPACK: Every successful message must replay from canonical node table and capability digest.
gates.N8_UNIVERSAL_POLYNOMIAL_BOUNDARY_ELIMINA: OPEN unless arbitrary-CNF formal polynomial bounds are proved.
